use_cases.title: Ship a SaaS or internal app
use_cases.question: I need to build and deploy an application quickly.
guidance: Start from the control plane and factory runtime.
Prefer assets with a reusable contract, setup docs, and QA evidence.
Fix any load-bearing-under-70 gap before building a new dependency on it.
